why: A (universe 0) is theorem_16_5_7 with side conjuncts isStructurableNe_iff, the ep-level theorem_14_1_9, tsupport_comp_subset_preimage', theorem_16_5_7_hyp and its witness. The two statements differ only in the partition-of-unity hypothesis: the main conjunct assumes that the object M-polyfold of every model S ∈ c̄ admits sc-smooth partitions of unity for arbitrary open covers (MPolyfold.AdmitsScPartitionsOfUnity), while B assumes c.polyfold.AdmitsScPartitionsOfUnity (Definition 16.1.5 (2): some model admits them in the ep-groupoid sense of Definition 7.5.5, saturated covers and invariant partitions). Theorem 7.5.7 (orbit space paracompact) turns A's hypothesis into B's, so B ⇒ A holds; all other hypotheses and the conclusion agree verbatim. A ⇒ B is proved with B's hypothesis replaced by A's (A_to_Bpu), so this is the only gap. Closing it needs ep-groupoid partitions of unity ⇒ M-polyfold partitions of unity of the object space (invariant bumps near the fixed point x of a local uniformizer, then paracompactness of the object space); we believe this holds but it is a real argument that the project does not contain. Side conjuncts in B ⇒ A: the main conjunct and theorem_16_5_7_hyp come from B; isStructurableNe_iff, tsupport_comp_subset_preimage', theorem_14_1_9 (from theorem_14_1_9_charged and SEP.exists_isTameChart) and the witness are re-proved outright from non-item lemmas.
